title: Portside Marine Electric — Harbor Light Industrial, Suite 210
summary: Triple-net industrial lease dated November 1, 2023 to Portside Marine Electric for Suite 210 (2,300 RSF), January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2030 at $17.40/RSF rising 4% a year. The First Amendment (July 15, 2025) adds Suite 212 (1,100 RSF) from September 1, 2025 at $18.10/RSF rising 4.0% each January 1 from 2027, raises Tenant's Share to 9.44% and gave an $8,800 allowance to be requested by June 30, 2026.
